source_row.rationale: Ongoing tracking of nurse-sensitive quality indicators such as fall rate and pressure injury incidence helps identify trends over time, evaluate the effectiveness of prevention interventions already in place, and guide targeted quality improvement efforts — a proactive, systems-level approach rather than a tool for individual staff punishment.
source_row.source_detail: Quality indicator trending is used to detect patterns, evaluate interventions, and target improvement; reviewed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: AHRQ — Quality Indicator Tracking for Continuous Improvement
